questions.question:
Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows with 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row I – A, B, C and D are seated and all of them are facing south.

In row II – V, X, Y and Z are seated and all of them are facing north.

B is the only neighbour of A and A sits exactly opposite Y. V sits at the extreme left end of their row and is exactly opposite C. D sits to the immediate left of C and exactly opposite X.

Who sits at the immediate left of Y?
questions.solution:
Given : 

 
• Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows with 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.
 
• In row I – A, B, C and D are seated and all of them are facing south.
 
• In row II – V, X, Y and Z are seated and all of them are facing north.

Explanation :

1) V sits at the extreme left end of their row and is exactly opposite C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/193e94de547c3f015391709cd1f8d7fafa2987043a0818549f903ac0f1e5f3ae.png] 

2) D sits to the immediate left of C and exactly opposite X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/594a52916b85d23450a45601f3bf856e570e8039b917cf8ec099316d690372d1.png] 

3) B is the only neighbour of A and A sits exactly opposite Y.

After positioning B, A and Y only one position is left in row - II which will be occupied by the only person left i.e Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d0a6d6fbc6e80216239ce334e9275c7dd60a4a46ebfc3e7323b4e778aa9d162.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Z sits at the immediate left of Y.

Hence, **"Z"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some tapes are glue.

Some glue are paints.

All paints are computers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some tapes are paints.

II. All glue are paints.

III. Some glue are computers.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b36e21c6a5be876db9b092ee8813c3b1489e179dd730ede42216ad5e245229f3.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some tapes are paints → Does not Follow (As, some tapes are glue and some glue are paints. So, it is possible but not definitely true.)

II. All glue are paints → Does not Follow (As, some glue are paints. So, some part of glue is common with paints therefore it is false.)

III. Some glue are computers → Follow (As, some glue are paints and all paints are computers . So, whole paints comes in computers and have some part common with glue therefore it is definitely true.)

So, Only conclusion III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusion III follows".

questions.question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

63, 60, 66, 57, ?
questions.solution:
**Logic :** Consecutive multiples of (3) are added and subtracted alternately.

So,

63 - 3 = 60

60 + 6 = 66

66 - 9 = 57

57 + 12 = **69**

Hence, **"69"** is the correct answer.

• R # P → R is the daughter of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd02d366cb8692b3663a8e78e59140f05abf1213838ec1fae0562284f564c85e.png]

questions.question:
Select the option which is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word (words should be treated as meaningful words and should not be related to each other on the basis of the number of letters/consonants/vowels in the word)

Cone : Shape :: Car : ______
questions.solution:
**Logic : **Type or category of the term : Term

So,

__
 
• **Cone** is a type of **shape**.

Similarly,

 
• **Car** is a type of **vehicle**.

Hence, **"Vehicle"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Tire → Part of the car.

questions.question: Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. E is sitting second to the right of B. F is the immediate neighbour of B and A. D is sitting second to the left of F. Who is sitting to the immediate right of C?
questions.solution:
**Given :** Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

**Explanation : **

1) E is sitting second to the right of B.

2) F is the immediate neighbour of B and A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/009da2093e0bb89b68ddb607ac80827e5f6754a3eae5f718ef8049b395991da0.png] 

3) D is sitting second to the left of F.

After positioning D only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0a63c87422c4b3afd4c2081dacfd8c3ef7e66d4b993dbc5db121c959a02d98d.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement E is sitting to the immediate right of C.

Hence, **"E"** is the correct answer.
